**12 issues found** across 108 files

**Note:** This PR contains a large number of files. Free-tier reviews are limited to 40 files per PR, so some files may not have been reviewed. cubic prioritises the most important files to review. Paid plans can review more files.

<details>
<summary>Prompt for AI agents (unresolved issues)</summary>

```text

Check if these issues are valid — if so, understand the root cause of each and fix them. If appropriate, use sub-agents to investigate and fix each issue separately.


<file name="sendfn/.conduct/specs/2026-04-02-audit-fix-82lwpp72-spec/phase-artifacts/PHASE_07-manual-vectors.ts">

<violation number="1" location="sendfn/.conduct/specs/2026-04-02-audit-fix-82lwpp72-spec/phase-artifacts/PHASE_07-manual-vectors.ts:26">
P1: The relative file URLs are incorrect and resolve under `.conduct/sendfn/...`, causing `readFileSync` to fail with missing-file errors.</violation>
</file>

<file name="sendfn/python/sendfn/__init__.py">

<violation number="1" location="sendfn/python/sendfn/__init__.py:47">
P2: Do not catch all `ModuleNotFoundError` cases here; re-raise when the missing module is not `superfunctions`/`superfunctions.db` to avoid masking real import failures inside `superfunctions.db`.</violation>
</file>

<file name="sendfn/python/sendfn/push/device_manager.py">

<violation number="1" location="sendfn/python/sendfn/push/device_manager.py:128">
P1: Deactivate-after-create ordering should be reversed to avoid losing push reachability when registration fails.</violation>

<violation number="2" location="sendfn/python/sendfn/push/device_manager.py:128">
P1: Refreshing one user’s token can deactivate other users’ records because deactivation is scoped only by token, not by user/platform.</violation>
</file>

<file name="sendfn/python/sendfn/_concurrency.py">

<violation number="1" location="sendfn/python/sendfn/_concurrency.py:40">
P1: Filtering out `None` at return time drops valid worker results and can reorder/shorten output relative to inputs.</violation>
</file>

<file name="sendfn/typescript/examples/event-handling.ts">

<violation number="1" location="sendfn/typescript/examples/event-handling.ts:11">
P1: Remove the hardcoded admin key fallback; it creates a predictable default credential when env configuration is missing.</violation>
</file>

<file name="sendfn/typescript/examples/push-notification.ts">

<violation number="1" location="sendfn/typescript/examples/push-notification.ts:12">
P2: Parse `FCM_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON` before passing it to `serviceAccountKey`; a raw JSON string is treated as a file path by Firebase Admin and breaks FCM initialization.</violation>
</file>

<file name="sendfn/.conduct/specs/2026-04-02-audit-fix-82lwpp72-spec/phases/PHASE_00.md">

<violation number="1" location="sendfn/.conduct/specs/2026-04-02-audit-fix-82lwpp72-spec/phases/PHASE_00.md:56">
P2: The repo-root install command uses the wrong path (`./python-core`), which will fail the verification step. Use `./packages/python-core` to match the actual package location.</violation>
</file>

<file name="sendfn/typescript/README.md">

<violation number="1" location="sendfn/typescript/README.md:32">
P2: The per-package verification command is incorrect for the stated context; `--workspace sendfn/typescript` fails when run inside that package directory.</violation>
</file>

<file name="sendfn/python/sendfn/suppression/manager.py">

<violation number="1" location="sendfn/python/sendfn/suppression/manager.py:100">
P2: Validate required fields in each bulk entry before indexing; otherwise malformed input raises `KeyError` instead of `ValidationError`.</violation>
</file>

<file name="sendfn/python/sendfn/database/memory.py">

<violation number="1" location="sendfn/python/sendfn/database/memory.py:140">
P2: `create_many` coerces ids to `str`, but `create` uses raw ids. This type mismatch can bypass duplicate-id checks and allow duplicate logical ids across methods.</violation>
</file>

<file name="sendfn/python/sendfn/email/aws_ses.py">

<violation number="1" location="sendfn/python/sendfn/email/aws_ses.py:269">
P2: `_error_code` is deriving retry/throttling from Python exception class names, but Boto3 SES service errors are usually `ClientError` with the real AWS code in `error.response['Error']['Code']`. This causes incorrect provider error codes in production paths.</violation>
</file>
```

</details>
